definitions.explanation: A person who has just joined a group, organization, or workplace.

examples.japanese: {新入|しんい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{新入|しんい}りだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、わからないこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: He's still a newcomer, so there's a lot he doesn't know.

examples.japanese: {新入|しんい}りだ⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}する→遠慮する：19518_enryosuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Just because you're new doesn't mean you have to hold back.

notes:
{新|しん} (new) + {入|い}り (entering). Refers to someone who has recently joined an organization or group and is still learning the ropes. The term has a slightly informal, colloquial feel and is commonly used in workplaces and clubs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新入|しんい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ — new employee
- {新入|しんい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧ — new member
- {新入|しんい}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧ — train the newcomer
- {新入|しんい}り⟦いじめ→いじめ：09092_ijime⟧ — hazing of newcomers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧ — newcomer; rookie — more formal and widely used in business and media
- ⟦{新入生|しんにゅうせい}→新入生：03073_shinnyuusei⟧ — new student; first-year student — specifically for schools
- ⟦{新米|しんまい}→新米：06877_shinmai⟧ — novice; greenhorn — more casual, emphasizes inexperience
